issues.title: refactor: Clean up PostAward sub-contractor controllers - extract shared logic, defer full merge
issues.description:
## Scope change (2026-05-08)

The original ask was to **merge** `PostAwardPrimeActionActiveSubContractorsController` into `PostAwardPrimeContractorController`. After analyzing both controllers and their call sites, the merge introduces real regression risk because **neither controller has any unit-test coverage today**, and they touch a junction table (`OneNList_PostAward_ActionActiveSubContractor_SmallBusinessCategory`) that is not exercised by any automated test.

This ticket has been **rescoped** to capture the high-value, low-risk cleanups now (Tier A + Tier B below) and **defer the full controller merge** until characterization tests exist as a regression net. The merge will be tracked as a follow-up ticket once this work is shipped.

---

## Background

Both controllers operate on the same EF entity (`OneNList_PostAward_ActionActiveSubContractor`). They are two phases of one workflow:

- `PostAwardPrimeContractorController.Select(...)` - bulk-pick from a checklist
- `PostAwardPrimeActionActiveSubContractorsController.Edit/Delete(...)` - per-row edit + delete

There is real duplication (~60% boilerplate, identical sproc call, same partial view) but also a real difference (the Edit path manages a junction table the Select path does not).

---

## In scope (this ticket)

### Tier A - zero-behavior-change hygiene

1. **Delete unused `ICPARSCMRAService` injection** from `PostAwardPrimeActionActiveSubContractorsController` (declared, never referenced).
2. **Move `[CustomAuthorize(PM)]` to class level** on `PostAwardPrimeActionActiveSubContractorsController` (currently scattered across action methods; same effective behavior, easier to audit, prevents a future public action from accidentally bypassing auth).
3. **Add brief XML doc comments** at the top of each controller explaining what each one actually does (the names mislead).

### Tier B - extract shared logic to the service layer

Both controllers do the same two operations. Push them into `IPostAward_ActionActiveSubContractorService`:

1. **New service method**: `Task<List<GetActiveSubContractorsWithSmallBusinessCategories>> GetForListAsync(int oneNListId)` - wraps the existing sproc call. Both controllers' `GetPostPrimeSubContTablePartial` collapses to a one-line call.
2. **Remove the static method** `PostAwardPrimeActionActiveSubContractorsController.GetActiveContractors(...)` - replace with a service call. The sole call site is `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Models/PostAwardPrimeSubContModel.cs:66`.

### Test addition (small)

Even without merging, add **one characterization test** for the new `GetForListAsync` service method. Verifies given-X-rows-in-DB returns the expected shape. ~30 minutes of work; valuable both as the only existing test for this code path and as the foundation for the future merge ticket.

---

## Out of scope (deferred)

- **The actual controller merge** (consolidating action methods of one controller into the other). Will be tracked as a separate ticket once characterization tests cover both controllers' full action surface.
- **Renaming for clarity** (e.g., `PostAwardPrimeContractorController` -> `PostAwardSubContractorListController`). A rename has the same blast radius as a merge (route changes, view folder changes) without the merge's structural benefit. Not worth the risk in isolation.

---

## Files to Modify

- `Source/OneNListApp.Service/IPostAward_ActionActiveSubContractorService.cs` - add `GetForListAsync` signature
- `Source/OneNListApp.Service/PostAward_ActionActiveSubContractorService.cs` - implement `GetForListAsync` (wraps the existing sproc call)
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Controllers/PostAwardPrimeContractorController.cs` - collapse `GetPostPrimeSubContTablePartial` to a service call; add XML doc comment
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Controllers/PostAwardPrimeActionActiveSubContractorsController.cs` - collapse `GetPostPrimeSubContTablePartial` to a service call; remove static `GetActiveContractors`; remove `ICPARSCMRAService` injection; move `[CustomAuthorize(PM)]` to class; add XML doc comment
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Models/PostAwardPrimeSubContModel.cs:66` - replace static-method call with service call (service must be passed in or otherwise accessible)
- `Source/OneNListApp.Tests/Service/PostAward_ActionActiveSubContractorServiceTests.cs` - new test file with one characterization test for `GetForListAsync`

---

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `ICPARSCMRAService` no longer injected into `PostAwardPrimeActionActiveSubContractorsController`
- [ ] `[CustomAuthorize(PM)]` is class-level on both controllers (not action-level)
- [ ] Both controllers have an XML doc comment explaining what they do
- [ ] `IPostAward_ActionActiveSubContractorService` exposes `GetForListAsync(int oneNListId)`
- [ ] Both controllers' `GetPostPrimeSubContTablePartial` calls the service rather than the sproc directly
- [ ] Static method `PostAwardPrimeActionActiveSubContractorsController.GetActiveContractors` is removed; the call site in `PostAwardPrimeSubContModel.cs` is updated to call the service
- [ ] One unit test exists for `GetForListAsync` verifying it returns the expected shape from a mocked sproc call
- [ ] All routes unchanged; no Razor views need updating
- [ ] Project builds with no errors and no new warnings
- [ ] All 320+ existing unit tests continue to pass
- [ ] Manual smoke test: load post-award action's "Prime Contractors" section, select 2-3 contractors, edit one (change Vendor ID, toggle a small-business category), reload, verify all values persist

---

## Follow-up ticket (to be created post-shipping)

> Merge `PostAwardPrimeActionActiveSubContractorsController` into `PostAwardPrimeContractorController` - original scope of #558. Now feasible because Tier B already extracted shared logic to the service, leaving only ~2 distinct action methods per controller. Requires characterization tests for the bulk-select + per-row-edit flows before merge.

issues.title: UX: Surface validation errors hidden inside collapsed accordions
issues.description:
## Summary
When a form is submitted with validation errors, the error scroll logic in
`onenlist.form.js` (lines 512–527) scrolls to the first error — but if that error
is inside a collapsed Bootstrap accordion panel, the panel stays closed and the
user sees nothing actionable. This causes confusion and repeated failed submissions.

**Affected file:** `Source/OneNListApp.Web/wwwroot/scripts/onenlist.form.js`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] On form submission failure, every accordion panel that contains at least one validation error is automatically expanded
- [ ] Every tab that contains at least one validation error is automatically activated
- [ ] After expanding panels/tabs, the page scrolls to the first visible error message
- [ ] A summary banner at the top of the form lists the count of validation errors (e.g., "3 errors must be corrected before saving")
- [ ] Existing behavior for forms without accordions is unchanged
- [ ] The fix works for both inline `span.field-validation-error` messages and summary `div.validation-summary-errors` blocks

issues.title: UX: Add advanced filtering to action item list view (per-column, org-configurable)
issues.description:
## Scope expansion (2026-05-08)

Original ask: a hardcoded set of filter inputs (Action Status, Award Date range, Funding Type, Service Code, Organization) above the list view.

**Expanded scope:** v5.1.2 shipped a per-org dynamic column configuration system (`Organization_ActionList_Column_Config` table + Admin > Action List Columns admin tool — tickets #707-#710). This ticket now extends that infrastructure so that **each org can independently flag which columns are filterable** in the admin tool, and the list view renders the appropriate filter input for each flagged column. The hardcoded filter list in the original AC becomes the *default* visible-and-filterable set for OrgID=1 (Vantage/Vantage North), with all other orgs configuring their own.

This consolidates two previously-separate concerns (which columns appear vs. which columns can be filtered) under one admin surface, so an org admin can manage their entire list-view experience in one place.

---

## Background

After v5.1.2 the list view already pulls column visibility, display name, and order from `Organization_ActionList_Column_Config`. Today the table has:
- `ID`, `fk_Organization_ID`, `ViewName`, `ColumnKey`, `DisplayName`, `IsVisible`, `DisplayOrder`

Today there is NO per-org filterability flag. The existing single text-search box is hardcoded into the view and applies a `LIKE %term%` scan over a fixed column set.

---

## Resolved design decisions (2026-05-08 review)

| Topic | Decision |
|---|---|
| **Performance baselining** | Capture list-query timing on a representative 10k+ row org BEFORE Phase 2 starts and AGAIN after Phase 2 ships. Concrete delta in the Phase 2 close-out comment. |
| **FilterType='lookup' category resolution** | **Hybrid**: hardcoded `Dictionary<ColumnKey, eLookups>` in `ListFilterHelper` provides defaults for known columns; optional `LookupCategoryId INT NULL` column on `Organization_ActionList_Column_Config` lets admins override per (org, view) row. Resolution order: row override → dictionary default → no lookup filter rendered. |
| **Multi-org Organization filter** | Render the Organization filter input ONLY for users whose access level grants cross-org visibility. Hidden entirely for single-org users. |
| **Filter chip ordering** | Chips sort by the column's `DisplayOrder` from `Organization_ActionList_Column_Config`, matching the table's column order. Stable, predictable, visually aligned with the table. |

---

## Implementation breakdown

This is intentionally larger than a single sprint. Recommend splitting into 3 sub-tickets that ship in order:

### Phase 1 — DB + Admin: filterability flag (~1 sprint)

**DB migration** (`Source/Migrations/5.1.X/NN_AddIsFilterableToColumnConfig.sql`):
- Add `IsFilterable BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0` column
- Add `FilterType NVARCHAR(20) NULL` column for the filter input type (`text`, `daterange`, `lookup`, `bool`, `numeric`)
- Add `LookupCategoryId INT NULL` column (per the Hybrid lookup-resolution decision) — null means "use the hardcoded dictionary default in `ListFilterHelper`"
- Backfill `FilterType` for known column keys based on the existing default column dictionary in `Source/Migrations/5.1.2/05_20260429_ProductionColumnConfigurations.sql`
- Backfill `IsFilterable=1` for the original ticket mandatory set on OrgID=1: ActionStatus, AwardDateInitial/Revised, ContractingAgency, PscCode, ProgramSupportedByAction; default to 0 elsewhere

**EF model** (`Organization_ActionList_Column_Config.cs`): add `IsFilterable bool`, `FilterType string?`, and `LookupCategoryId int?` properties.

**Service** (`ActionListColumnConfigService.cs`): existing `GetByOrgAndViewAsync` already returns the full row; no signature change needed. Add a convenience method `GetFilterableForOrgAndViewAsync(int orgId, string viewName)` that returns only `IsVisible=1 AND IsFilterable=1` rows.

**Admin UI** (`Areas/Admin/Views/ActionListColumnConfig/Index.cshtml`):
- Add "Filterable" checkbox column next to the existing "Visible" column in each per-view tab
- Add a "Filter type" dropdown next to it (text/daterange/lookup/bool/numeric)
- Add an optional "Lookup category" dropdown — only enabled when FilterType is `lookup`. Populated from `eLookups` enum values. Blank = use code-side default.
- Master toggle for "All filterable" mirroring the "All visible" pattern (#710)
- Sortable column header on the new checkbox

**Acceptance for Phase 1:**
- New columns exist on the table with correct backfill values
- Admin tool persists Filterable + FilterType + optional LookupCategoryId per row
- Existing list view behavior unchanged (no filtering yet) — Phase 2 wires it up

### Phase 2 — List view: render filter inputs (~1 sprint)

**Phase 2 step 1 — performance baseline (BEFORE any code changes):**
- Use a representative 10k+ row org (largest production org by action count)
- Measure: cold-cache and warm-cache page load time for `/PULSE/List`, `/PULSE/List?status=2`, etc.
- Record SQL execution time for the underlying `OneNList` query via SQL Server profiler or EF logging
- Capture in a comment on this ticket as the baseline

**Partial view** `Views/List/_FilterPanel.cshtml` (new): collapsible panel with one input per filterable column, rendered based on `FilterType`:
- `text` → standard text input
- `daterange` → two date pickers (from / to)
- `lookup` → multi-select dropdown populated from the existing `GetLookupItemsFor` sproc. Lookup category resolved as: `LookupCategoryId` column on the row → dictionary default in `ListFilterHelper` → no input rendered (with a console warning so the misconfig is visible to devs)
- `bool` → tri-state (Yes / No / Any)
- `numeric` → min/max input pair
- **Organization filter**: rendered ONLY when the current user's access level grants cross-org visibility (check via `SessionManager.userAccessLevel()` against the appropriate threshold). Single-org users never see it.

**Helper class** `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Helpers/ListFilterHelper.cs` (new):
- `Dictionary<string, Enumerations.eLookups> DefaultLookupCategories` — static defaults
- `eLookups? ResolveLookupCategory(Organization_ActionList_Column_Config row)` — applies the Hybrid resolution order
- `Dictionary<ColumnKey, FilterValue> ParseQueryString(IQueryCollection q)` — converts query-string params into typed filter values

**Controller** (`ListController.cs`): new `Index` action overload that accepts the filter dictionary, builds an EF predicate per column, applies before paging. Use `IQueryable<OneNListItem>.Where(...)` chaining so unspecified columns are no-ops. Existing text search continues to work and is logically AND-ed with column filters.

**JS** (`wwwroot/scripts/onenlist.filtering.js`):
- show/hide panel; serialize inputs into a query string; replace `window.location` to apply
- Render active-filter chips with X-to-remove. **Chip order: by the `DisplayOrder` of each filter's column** (sort chips client-side using the data-attribute `data-display-order` rendered from server-side config)
- Filter chips below the panel

**Phase 2 step N — performance baseline (AFTER):**
- Re-run the same measurements from step 1
- Compare; investigate if any > 20% regression
- Append to the same ticket comment as the after-baseline

**Acceptance for Phase 2:**
- Filter panel renders for any column where `IsFilterable=1` for the user's org
- Filters apply via query string (no all-records load)
- Active filters render as removable chips, sorted by column `DisplayOrder`
- "Showing X of Y items" count appears above the table
- Existing text search still works in parallel
- Refresh / back-button preserves filter state via URL
- Organization filter renders only for cross-org users
- Performance baseline before/after captured in ticket comment; no regression > 20%

### Phase 3 — Polish + tests (~half sprint)

- Filter state persistence across navigation: store last-used filters per (user, view) in session; restore on return
- Unit tests for `ListFilterHelper` (every FilterType + edge cases: empty values, malformed dates, hybrid lookup resolution with and without override)
- Unit tests for the new controller filter-application logic (Moq + IQueryable test data)
- Unit test confirming chips render in `DisplayOrder` sequence
- Unit test confirming Organization filter is hidden for single-org users
- E2E test: apply a filter, verify URL params, verify result count, click chip-X, verify filter clears

---

## Files to Modify (full list)

**Phase 1:**
- `Source/Migrations/5.1.X/NN_AddIsFilterableToColumnConfig.sql` (new)
- `Source/OneNListApp.Data/Models/Organization_ActionList_Column_Config.cs`
- `Source/OneNListApp.Service/IActionListColumnConfigService.cs`
- `Source/OneNListApp.Service/ActionListColumnConfigService.cs`
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Areas/Admin/Views/ActionListColumnConfig/Index.cshtml`
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Areas/Admin/Controllers/ActionListColumnConfigController.cs`
- `Source/OneNListApp.Tests/Service/ActionListColumnConfigServiceTests.cs`

**Phase 2:**
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Views/List/_FilterPanel.cshtml` (new)
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Views/List/Index.cshtml`
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Controllers/ListController.cs`
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Helpers/ListFilterHelper.cs` (new)
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/wwwroot/scripts/onenlist.filtering.js`
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/wwwroot/css/onenlist.css`

**Phase 3:**
- `Source/OneNListApp.Tests/Web/ListFilterHelperTests.cs` (new)
- `Source/OneNListApp.Tests/Web/ListControllerFilterTests.cs` (new)
- `Source/OneNListApp.E2E/Tests/ListFilterTests.cs` (new)
- `Source/OneNListApp.E2E/Pages/ListPage.cs` (extended with filter helpers)

---

## Acceptance Criteria

### Phase 1 (DB + Admin)
- [ ] `Organization_ActionList_Column_Config` has `IsFilterable BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`, `FilterType NVARCHAR(20) NULL`, and `LookupCategoryId INT NULL`
- [ ] Migration is idempotent and backfills sensible defaults for the column set seeded in 5.1.2/05
- [ ] Admin > Action List Columns shows a Filterable checkbox + FilterType dropdown + Lookup Category dropdown (last enabled only when FilterType=lookup); values persist on save
- [ ] Master "All filterable" toggle works in each view tab
- [ ] EF model includes the three new properties
- [ ] All existing 323+ unit tests pass; no new warnings; build clean

### Phase 2 (List view filtering)
- [ ] Performance baseline captured BEFORE coding begins (timings on representative 10k+ row org)
- [ ] Collapsible filter panel above the action item list
- [ ] One input rendered per filterable column for the user's org, of the correct type per `FilterType`
- [ ] Hybrid lookup resolution: row's `LookupCategoryId` → dictionary default → no-render (with dev console warning)
- [ ] Hardcoded original-ticket filter set is the default for OrgID=1: Action Status, Award Date range, Funding Type, Service Code, Organization
- [ ] Organization filter renders only for users with cross-org access
- [ ] Filters appended as query-string parameters; server-side application via `IQueryable.Where`
- [ ] Active filters shown as removable chips below the panel, sorted by column `DisplayOrder`
- [ ] Filter state preserved via URL params on navigate-away-and-back
- [ ] Existing text search continues to work, logically AND-ed with column filters
- [ ] "Showing X of Y items" count displayed
- [ ] No client-side filtering of full result set (server applies filters before paging)
- [ ] Performance baseline re-captured AFTER; no regression > 20% on warm-cache page load. Both numbers posted as a comment on this ticket.

### Phase 3 (Polish + tests)
- [ ] Per-user, per-view session storage of last-applied filters; restored on return
- [ ] `ListFilterHelper` unit tests cover every `FilterType` + edge cases + hybrid lookup resolution (with override and without)
- [ ] `ListController` filter-application unit tests pass with Moq + EF InMemory
- [ ] Chip-ordering unit test: chips render in `DisplayOrder` sequence
- [ ] Org-filter visibility unit test: hidden for single-org users, shown for cross-org users
- [ ] E2E test exercises filter-apply / chip-remove / URL-restore round trip
- [ ] All existing unit/integration tests continue to pass

---

## Architecture notes

- **Builds on v5.1.2 work**: `Organization_ActionList_Column_Config` is the source of truth for column visibility/order/labels/filterability/lookup-category. Adding the three new columns keeps that single-source-of-truth pattern. Do NOT introduce a parallel "filterable columns" config table.
- **Filter type is metadata, not behavior**: the same `FilterType` that drives admin-UI rendering also drives list-view input rendering. One column, one FilterType per (org, view) row.
- **Server-side only**: explicitly NOT a client-side DataTables-style filter that loads all rows. Performance matters for the larger orgs (10k+ items).
- **No new sprocs**: filtering uses EF `IQueryable` chaining against the existing `OneNList` set, joined with related lookups via `.Include()` only where the filter requires it.
- **Backward compat**: orgs without any `IsFilterable=1` rows see the existing list view exactly as today (panel collapsed and empty, or hidden).

---

## Out of scope (this ticket family)

- Saved filter "presets" (named filter combinations). Defer to future work.
- Cross-view filter sharing (e.g. apply Recent filters to Awarded). Defer.
- Excel export of filtered results. Defer; existing export remains unfiltered for now.

issues.title: UX: Fix modal dialog stacking and page-lock issues
issues.description:
## Summary
PULSE modal dialogs can stack on top of each other when a user opens a modal from
within another modal (e.g., editing a lookup value while viewing a record detail).
The z-index management in `onenlist.modal.js` (lines 88–90) does not account for
nested modals, resulting in incorrect layering. In some cases, closing a child modal
leaves the Bootstrap modal backdrop in place, locking the page and requiring a full
browser refresh.

**Affected file:** `Source/OneNListApp.Web/wwwroot/scripts/onenlist.modal.js`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Opening a modal from within another modal renders the child modal above the parent with correct z-index
- [ ] Closing the child modal removes only the child backdrop and restores the parent modal to interactive state
- [ ] Closing the parent modal removes all backdrops and returns full page interactivity
- [ ] The page is never left in a locked/unresponsive state after any sequence of modal open/close operations
- [ ] Escape key closes the topmost modal only, not all modals
- [ ] Regression test: open record → open edit sub-item modal → close sub-item → page is interactive → close parent → page is fully interactive

issues.title: UX: Improve user-facing error messages across the application
issues.description:
## Summary
Error messages throughout PULSE are too generic to be actionable. Examples:
- API responses return `"Error processing request"` with no detail
- AJAX error callbacks call `alert(error)` which can show raw exception text or a
  cryptic HTTP status code
- Bulk upload errors reference column indices instead of column names
- Form validation errors reference property names (`fk_OneNList_ID`) instead of
  display names

**Affected files:**
- `Source/OneNListApp.API/Controllers/OneNlistsController.cs:93`
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/wwwroot/scripts/onenlist.modal.js:159`
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Controllers/BulkUploadController.cs`

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All API error responses use a consistent JSON structure: `{ "error": { "code": "...", "message": "..." } }`
- [ ] HTTP 500 responses return a generic user-safe message ("An unexpected error occurred. Please try again or contact support.") without stack trace details
- [ ] HTTP 400/422 responses return field-level validation errors mapped to human-readable display names
- [ ] Bulk upload error reports reference column header names (e.g., "Award Date") not column indices
- [ ] AJAX error handlers in JavaScript display the message from the API error JSON if available, not raw HTTP status text
- [ ] A centralized exception filter (`IExceptionFilter` or middleware) is used to enforce the consistent response format
- [ ] At least 3 existing error path unit tests are updated to assert the new structured response format

issues.title: feat: Add IsmVSATAction column to OneNList and update action description stored procedures
issues.description:
## Summary

Adds the `IsmVSATAction` bit column to the `OneNList` table and updates the stored procedure so the FieldSat checkbox value can be persisted. Also seeds `System_FieldMetadata` rows to make the field **visible by default for OrgID=1 (Vantage/Vantage North) and hidden for all other orgs**, matching the FieldMetadata admin-toggle pattern already used by Baymark, Northline, ActionSupportedBy, and similar fields. Admins can unhide it for additional orgs using the existing Admin > Fields tool.

This migration must be applied before the app-layer ticket (#712).

## Files to Modify

- `Source/Migrations/5.1.2/07_<date>_AddIsmVSATActionField.sql` — new migration file containing all three steps below

## Migration Steps

### Step 1 — Add column to OneNList

```sql
ALTER TABLE [OneNList].[dbo].[OneNList]
    ADD [IsmVSATAction] BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0;
GO
```

### Step 2 — Update UpdateActionDescriptionSection stored procedure

```sql
ALTER PROCEDURE [dbo].[UpdateActionDescriptionSection]
    -- existing params ...
    @IsmVSATAction BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
    UPDATE [dbo].[OneNList]
    SET
        -- existing SET columns ...
        IsmVSATAction = @IsmVSATAction
    WHERE ID = @ID;
END
GO
```

### Step 3 — Seed System_FieldMetadata (one row per org)

```sql
INSERT INTO [OneNList].[dbo].[System_FieldMetadata]
    (ContainerTypeName, FieldName, DisplayName, ShortDisplayName, Description,
     IsRequired, IsHidden, fk_Organization_ID, ConditionallyRequired,
     IsFiltered, IsDuplicate, AllowDateNA)
VALUES
    ('ActionDescription|System.Boolean', 'IsmVSATAction', 'FieldSat Action', NULL, NULL, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0),  -- Vantage North/Vantage (Org 1): VISIBLE
    ('ActionDescription|System.Boolean', 'IsmVSATAction', 'FieldSat Action', NULL, NULL, 0, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0),  -- Beacon (Org 2): hidden
    ('ActionDescription|System.Boolean', 'IsmVSATAction', 'FieldSat Action', NULL, NULL, 0, 1, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0),  -- Union (Org 3): hidden
    ('ActionDescription|System.Boolean', 'IsmVSATAction', 'FieldSat Action', NULL, NULL, 0, 1, 4, 0, 0, 0, 0);  -- JPO Meridian (Org 4): hidden
GO
```

**Note:** `IsDuplicate = 0` because FieldSat status is not inherited when cloning an action (same rationale as Baymark/Northline).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `IsmVSATAction` column exists on `OneNList` table with `BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`
- [ ] `UpdateActionDescriptionSection` SP accepts and persists `@IsmVSATAction`
- [ ] Four rows exist in `System_FieldMetadata` for `IsmVSATAction`, one per org
- [ ] OrgID=1 row has `IsHidden=0`; OrgIDs 2, 3, 4 have `IsHidden=1`
- [ ] Admin > Fields tool shows the FieldSat Action field and allows toggling visibility per org
- [ ] Migration is idempotent (safe to re-run)
- [ ] All existing unit tests continue to pass

issues.title: feat: Add FieldSat Action checkbox to Action Description tab with org-wide visibility for Central Riverside
issues.description:
## Summary

Adds the FieldSat Action checkbox to the Action Description tab on the Item Create/Edit form. Visibility is controlled entirely by the existing `FieldMetadata` / `System_FieldMetadata` system — the field is hidden for all orgs except Vantage/Vantage North (seeded in migration #711) and can be unhidden by admins for other orgs via Admin > Fields. No security group flags, no read-only logic, and no list-view query changes are needed.

Depends on: #711 (DB migration must be applied first).

## Files to Modify

- `Source/OneNListApp.Data/Models/OneNList.cs` — add `IsmVSATAction` property
- `Source/OneNListApp.Web/Models/ItemActionDescriptionViewModel.cs` — add ViewModel property + `[FieldMetadata]` attribute + `hdIsmVSATAction` backing field; update `SetSectionValues()` and `GetSectionValues()`
- `Source/OneNListApp.Service/OneNItemUpdateHelper.cs` (or equivalent) — pass `IsmVSATAction` to the `UpdateActionDescriptionSection` SP call
- `Source/OneNListApp.Tests/` — add unit test covering the helper/service update path

## Implementation Details

### OneNList EF Model (`OneNList.cs`)
Add alongside the existing `IsCHSPurchase` / `IsNorthlinePurchase` properties:
```csharp
public bool? IsmVSATAction { get; set; }
```

### ViewModel (`ItemActionDescriptionViewModel.cs`)
Add alongside `IsCHSPurchase` / `IsNorthlinePurchase` following the same pattern:
```csharp
[Display(Name = "FieldSat Action")]
[FieldMetadata(AllowDuplicate = false, AllowHidden = true)]
public bool IsmVSATAction { get; set; }

public bool hdIsmVSATAction { get; set; }
```

Update `SetSectionValues()`:
```csharp
model.IsmVSATAction = IsmVSATAction;
```

Update `GetSectionValues()`:
```csharp
IsmVSATAction   = model.IsmVSATAction ?? false,
hdIsmVSATAction = model.IsmVSATAction ?? false,
```

### Service / Update Helper
Pass the new parameter to the stored procedure call, following the same pattern as `IsCHSPurchase` / `IsNorthlinePurchase`.

### Rendering
The checkbox renders automatically via the existing FieldMetadata partial/display templates — no Razor view changes are needed. The `FieldMetadataProvider` reads `System_FieldMetadata` at runtime and shows or hides the field per the current org's configuration. For orgs where the field is hidden, it is simply not rendered on the form.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Checkbox labeled "FieldSat Action" appears on the Action Description tab for Vantage/Vantage North users
- [ ] Checkbox does NOT appear for Beacon, Union, or JPO Meridian users (hidden by default)
- [ ] Checking and saving the box persists `IsmVSATAction = 1` in the `OneNList` table
- [ ] Unchecking and saving persists `IsmVSATAction = 0`
- [ ] Duplicating an action does NOT copy the FieldSat flag (same behavior as Baymark/Northline)
- [ ] Admin > Fields tool allows an org admin to unhide the field for their org
- [ ] No changes to permission TVFs, security group flags, or read-only helpers
- [ ] Project builds with no errors or warnings
- [ ] All existing unit tests continue to pass

## Unit Test Requirements
